categories.main_business_segments: Beijing SuperMap Software Co., Ltd. primarily operates in geographic information software (GIS) and spatial intelligence. Its main business includes GIS foundational software, industry application software for sectors such as natural resources, urban construction, water conservancy, meteorology, and enterprises, as well as SaaS GIS online services. The company also focuses on emerging areas like low-altitude economy and commercial aerospace through spatial data and AI integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops proprietary GIS foundational software with six major technology systems including big data GIS, new generation remote sensing software, 3D GIS, geospatial AI, distributed GIS, and cross-platform GIS. It emphasizes cloud-native architecture, AI integration, and cross-platform capabilities. The company also develops AI-powered spatial intelligence platforms, remote sensing image processing, and digital twin technologies, leveraging advanced algorithms and large model adaptations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SuperMap serves government agencies, enterprises, and public institutions across over 100 cities in China and more than 100 countries globally. Key sectors include natural resources, urban planning, water conservancy, meteorology, emergency management, transportation, energy, finance, and commercial aerospace. Its customers range from local to central government departments, large enterprises, and international clients in Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with dedicated regional divisions covering East China, South China, North China, Central China, Northwest, Northeast, and Southwest regions. Internationally, it has a presence in over 20 countries with local offices and agents in more than 50 countries, including Japan, Hong Kong, and Middle Eastern markets such as Saudi Arabia.
categories.supply_chain_position: SuperMap operates primarily in the midstream segment of the GIS software supply chain, developing core GIS foundational software and industry-specific application solutions. It also provides SaaS services and spatial data platforms, positioning itself as a technology provider and solution integrator rather than a hardware manufacturer or end-user service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in AI integration with spatial intelligence, including the development of a comprehensive geospatial AI technology base and intelligent agents. It focuses on upgrading GIS foundational software, expanding AI+ industry applications, advancing remote sensing integration, and developing digital twin and low-altitude economy solutions. R&D efforts emphasize autonomous innovation, cross-platform capabilities, and deep industry application penetration.
categories.revenue_model: SuperMap generates revenue mainly through software product sales under permanent licensing and subscription models, especially for its GIS foundational software. It also earns from SaaS subscriptions for online GIS services, technical consulting, system integration, and industry-specific application solutions. Additionally, the company receives income from government contracts, service fees, and rental income from leasing idle properties.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SuperMap is a leading GIS software provider in China and ranks third globally and first in Asia according to ARC Advisory Group. It competes primarily with major international GIS software vendors, maintaining a dominant domestic market share since 2015. The company is recognized as a pioneer in secure, autonomous GIS software and a key player in the national information technology innovation ecosystem.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SuperMap reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.5 billion, a 24.3% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 171 million. The company experienced challenges due to market conditions and organizational restructuring but maintains a total asset base of about RMB 4 billion. Despite recent declines, it continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures exceeding 25% of revenue, and pursues growth through diversification and international expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SuperMap emphasizes its strong autonomous innovation capability, secure and controllable GIS foundational software, and comprehensive spatial intelligence solutions. Its products offer high performance, cross-platform compatibility, and integration with AI and big data technologies. The company differentiates itself through deep industry expertise, extensive ecosystem partnerships, and leadership in national digital infrastructure projects, providing a reliable and innovative spatial data technology base for digital government, smart cities, and emerging industries.
